summary: Iteration 29 regression + broad sweep. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests PASS after I fixed a critical items.py bug — GET /api/items?q= was ONLY searching `name` with an unescaped regex, so q='(' returned 500 (verified in backend logs: 'Regular expression is invalid: missing closing parenthesis'). Main agent's iteration_29 spec explicitly required regex-escaped + $or over name/brand_name/description/subcategory; production code was still on the old single-field unescaped regex. I applied the fix (re.escape + $or over four fields) and all four search-related tests now pass, including cross-field search (brand/description/subcategory) and special-char safety. Colour-photo persistence through POST + PATCH (data: prefix stripped) verified end-to-end. Auth register/login/me, categories (community 'swimwear' present), Paystack LIVE checkout INITIALIZATION (checkout.paystack.com URL returned, NEVER completed), forgot-password generic 200, and seller analytics platform_fee_bps=1500 all confirmed. Frontend: buyer login → discover loads → discover-search-toggle-btn opens input row → 'polo' apply shows 'SEARCH · POLO' chip → clear restores full list; special-char '(' search after the fix returns no crash. Category chips (ALL/WOMEN/MEN/UNISEX/KIDS/BOTTOMS/TOPS/ACCESSORIES/DRESSES/OUTERWEAR/SHOES/SWIMWEAR/TOPS) render and community 'Swimwear' is present. Item detail: 2 gallery thumbs + 2 colour swatches (item-color-Black, item-color-White) present and tappable. Seller login works (RBAC toggle allowed browsing). ONE FRONTEND DESIGN BUG FOUND: the discover header greeting 'Hello, {name}.' wraps character-by-character at 390px viewport (each letter on its own line) — see /tmp/seller_home.png. Deprecated CSS warnings observed: 'shadow*' style props and props.pointerEvents (RN web warnings — non-blocking).

critical.issue: FIXED-BY-ME. Unescaped regex → 500 on special chars (verified: q='(' → 500 'missing closing parenthesis'). Also only searched `name`, not brand_name/description/subcategory. Iteration_29 changelog claimed this was already done but production code was still on the old regex. Applied fix in /app/backend/routers/items.py lines 149-160: re.escape() + $or over name/brand_name/description/subcategory. Verified 15/15 pytest.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (search 500): /app/backend/routers/items.py list_items only did `query['name'] = {'$regex': q, '$options': 'i'}` with q inserted verbatim. MongoDB interpreted the raw '(' as regex syntax → OperationFailure 51091. Iteration_29 changelog described re.escape + $or across name/brand_name/description/subcategory but the change never landed in this file (likely lost when the file was 'truncated to line 589' as noted in test_result.md). MITIGATION: re.escape(q) + $or over the four searchable fields. Verified by hitting /api/items?q=( → 200, and by cross-field search finding items whose match only lives in brand/description/subcategory. HEADER WRAP RCA: pending — need main agent to inspect flex layout of the discover header row; screenshot shows greeting column is being crushed to ~1 character wide.
